load_yaml_config: load a YAML configuration file and return it as a dictionary for argbind usage
parse_args_with_config: parse CLI arguments and merge them with YAML configuration file values
create_yaml_config_loader: create a function that loads YAML config files and validates they contain top-level mappings
build_argbind_config_parser: build a config parser that unifies CLI arguments with YAML configuration using argbind.scope
test_parse_args_with_config: test the parse_args_with_config function with and without a YAML config path argument
